question: Two scripts may update the same record at once. How do I make my `client.items.update` fail instead of silently overwriting, and which error code tells me to retry?
key: Send `meta: { current_version }` from the read; on conflict the API answers `STALE_ITEM_VERSION`.

question: How many records can one `client.items.bulkPublish` call take?
A record has three localized fields, all with `en` and `it`. I want to add a Spanish value to just one of them with `client.items.update`. Can I send only that field?
judge: Says no: all localized fields of a record must share the same set of locales, so adding a locale means sending every localized field with the new locale key (with a value or null) in the same update.
key: No. Adding a locale changes the record's locale set: send every localized field with the `es` key (value or null).

question: I call `client.items.find(id, { version: "published" })` on a record that was never published. What do I get?
judge: Says the call fails with a not-found error (NOT_FOUND / 404); it does not fall back to the current draft.
key: `NOT_FOUND`: there is no fallback to the draft.

question: How do I publish only the English content of a record, leaving other locales unpublished?
Which CMA client method checks whether a new record would pass validation without saving it?
I restore an old version of a record with `client.itemVersions.restore`. The model has draft mode turned off. Is the restored content published?
judge: Says yes: when the model has draft mode disabled, restoring a version publishes the restored content automatically.
key: Yes. Without draft mode, restore auto-publishes.

question: Publishing a child record of a tree model fails with `UNPUBLISHED_PARENT`. Which option publishes the parents along with it?
A model has `all_locales_required: true` and the project has locales en and it. Can I create a record sending a localized title only for `en`?
judge: Says no: every locale key is required in each localized field (the value of a locale may be null, but the key must be present).
key: No. Every locale key must be present (null allowed as the value).

question: On which condition does the CMA save a record that fails validators such as `required` instead of rejecting it?
key: When the model has `draft_saving_active: true` (with draft mode): it is saved as an invalid draft; publishing still enforces validators.
